evals.name: docker-compose-three-tier
evals.prompt: Here is the docker-compose.yml for our three-tier web app: an nginx frontend, a Node API and a Postgres database. Can you diagram it as an isometric figure I can drop into the README? I want the API and the database clearly labeled, and I want to see requests flowing through it.
expect: Produces a single standalone HTML file with no external assets or network requests
Labels the API and database parts
Renders an animated request flow between the tiers
The scene passes the geometry audit

evals.name: kafka-event-pipeline
evals.prompt: Draw me a diagram of a Kafka event pipeline: a producer publishes to a topic with three partitions, a stream processor consumes it, and the result goes to a sink. There is no compose file, so build it from this description. Dark theme, please, and show the jobs flowing with a readout that includes consumer lag.
expect: Builds the scene from the plain-language description without a config file
Represents the topic with three partitions
Animates a jobs flow through the producer, processor and sink
Includes a readout entry for consumer lag

evals.name: kubernetes-and-ci
evals.prompt: I have a Kubernetes Deployment (3 replicas behind a Service) and a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds and pushes the image. Make me one isometric diagram of both, with the CI steps connected by cables, and hover highlighting on the parts.
expect: Outputs a single standalone HTML file
Shows the three replicas and the Service
Connects the CI steps with cable links
Enables hover highlighting on the parts
